Based on my searches through the MemPalace index, I've identified all source files that import from the token-bucket rate limiter module at `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`. The module exports:
- `consumeRateLimit` (function)
- `getBucketConfig` (function)
- `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS` (bucket table)
- `resetRateLimits` (test-only reset function)
- `setOrgPlan` (test-only config lookup)
